promptTemplate: Production game-library asset: ONE luxury vintage upright arcade machine, full body from top marquee to base, centered straight-on frontal view with subtly visible bevelled depth, isolated on real transparent alpha. Tall portrait composition about 2:3. Exact common cabinet structure: broad blank dark illuminated marquee at top (between 8 and 17 percent height), thick polished black walnut/black enamel housing, brass edge piping, glowing themed color inset trim; a large CRT display between 23 and 58 percent height; sloped control deck with physical joystick and six colorful glossy buttons between 60 and 70 percent; lower illustrated kickplate, metal coin slots, little speaker grille and feet. Premium realistic rendered collectible machine with illustrated screen and side artwork. Theme for game {title}: {subject}. The screen is an exciting legible game illustration. Kickplate has complementary themed illustration. Cohesive Emerald Arcade family with elegant luxury materials and vivid accent light, beautiful high detail, crisp silhouette. Entire machine inside frame with 5% empty margins. No text, letters, numbers, watermarks or logos anywhere, particularly leave the top marquee empty and almost black for an HTML title overlay. No room, floor, ground shadow, objects outside the machine. This machine will be displayed about 300px wide.
